explanation: Memoize the best value for each item-prefix and remaining capacity. Compare skipping the final item with taking it once and reducing the available capacity; recurse only to earlier items.
timeComplexity: O(n(C+1)) time for n items and capacity C.
spaceComplexity: O(n(C+1)) memo space and O(n) recursion depth.
